messages:
maria: Quick microprobe results for pegasusX-11b-int5 (hybrid int5). Ran ~5k evals across chat/longform slices. TL;DR: ~30% infra cost reduction vs our 13b-int8 baseline, latency p95 improved, small drop on longform coherence (narrow slices only). Can GTN consider mixed routing?

devin: numbers pls — and what was the batch/seq config?

maria: ran on dedicated dev pool, bs=8, seq=1024 for longform, seq=256 for chat. Mini summary:
```
slice        | p50  | p95  | relative_cost | quality_vs_13b-int8
chat-short   | 12ms | 70ms | -32%          | +0.1% intent acc
multiturn    | 18ms | 120ms| -29%          | -0.2% conv coh
longform     | 45ms | 260ms| -31%          | -1.3% ROUGE
```
Note: quality diffs small except longform where we saw a consistent drift on hallucination signals.

sam: hmm. sounds promising for chat flows. My take: route conversational and single-turn queries to pegX-int5; keep longform and synthetic prompts on 13b-int8 for now. Add a fallback to 13b if novelty score drops >0.5.

leah-product: How does that map to unit econ for a typical GTN customer? If we shift 40% traffic, what savings? Also what are the user-facing risks?

maria: rough econ: per-1M tokens cost (infra only): 13b-int8 = $12.0, pegX-int5 = $8.2 -> ~31.6% saving. If GTN routes 40% chat (high-vol), net platform CPT decreases ~12% overall. User risk: slight longform regressions affecting long summaries and multi-document synth. For SLAs we should instrument quality regressions per prompt-set and surface regressions in Console.

ops-bot: Note: observed KV-cache warmup penalty on int5 variant on cold starts — p95 spikes ~2x first 30s of a new model node. Recommend small warmup pool or staged rollout.

devin: propose rollout plan: canary 2% traffic (chat-only) -> 10% after 24h if no quality alerts -> 40% after 1 week with hybrid routing rule. Add auto-fallback to 13b-int8 on any slice-level regression >0.7.

sam: +1. also add slight priming adjustments for longform prompts to reduce hallucination (few-shot examples).

leah-product: ok sounds actionable. I'll draft a short GTN recommendation: hybrid routing for chat, hold longform until targeted evals pass, canary plan as above. Please drop the small eval set and perf dashboard link here and I'll sync with growth. :thumbsup:

maria: dropping eval link and a 200-sample longform failure list to the PR in a min. Thanks all.

ops-bot: deploy note: canary scheduled to start 3032120000 UTC.
